title: Nine Miles of Road
subtitle: 汽车与交通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 汽车与交通（生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：汽车与交通（生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：car　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 car 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 my mother was sent to drive ① a car she could not start, and she said the starting was the whole of the lesson. The ② car, meaning the machine and not the journey, was nine miles from home and was driven by whoever came last; a car, she said, is the only thing in a garage that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ car in that garage had the same key, and the ④ car at the end, meaning the one the mechanic kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever drove properly. A car, my grandmother said, is nine parts steel and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the steel is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ car was the whole of the journey, meaning the miles it gave and not the machine. The ⑥ car, meaning the journey and not any of that, is the only thing in a family that everybody borrows and nobody questions; a car, he said, is either something you drive or the only word that means both a machine and a journey. She said the journey is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ car had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the key. The ⑧ car of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine miles and eleven years of driving; a car, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ car I remember is the one at the end, which was sold in 1976 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ car, my grandmother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being driven; every car, she said, is a journey that has agreed to look like a machine. She said the journey was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 汽车（指那台机器本身，与旅程相对）
C. 固定搭配：drive a car 开一辆车
D. n. 汽车（指车库里每一辆）
E. n. 汽车（指末尾那一辆）
F. n. 汽车（抽象：它给出的那段旅程）
G. n. 那段旅程（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a car she could not start
The car, meaning the machine and not the journey
car was the whole of the journey
the car had become a photograph in a report
The car of the whole thing
A car, my grandmother said in 1980

answers.why: drive a car 意为“开一辆车”，1955 年母亲被派去开一辆她发动不了的车。
car 意为“汽车”，指那台机器本身而不是旅程，离家九英里，由最后走的人开走。
car 指车库里每一辆车，每一辆都是同样的钥匙。
car 指末尾那一辆（修理工留的那一辆），是唯一有人认真开过的。
car 意为“汽车”，抽象指它给出的那段旅程，父亲说 car 就是那趟旅程的全部。
car 为抽象用法，指那段旅程本身，是一家人人人都借、却没人质疑的东西。
car 意为“汽车、小轿车”，到 1971 年这辆 car 成了报告里的一张照片。
car 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英里和十一年的驾驶。
car 意为“汽车”，我记得的是末尾那一辆，1976 年卖掉，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
car 为抽象总称，祖母说汽车是唯一会因为被开动而变好的东西。
